title: Fecal Microbiota Transplant by Oral Capsules With Lactobacilli for Recurrent Clostridium Difficile Infection
brief_summary: Investigators designed an open, two-arm study to compare fecal microbiota transplant by oral capsules (FMT-c ) versus FMT-c enriched with Lactobacillus for treatment of C. difficile recurrent infection
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Older than 18 years With recurrent CDI

Exclusion Criteria:Older than 18 years
